# danielcward.com

> Daniel C. Ward is a UK-based web developer, photographer and tinkerer. He
> designs and builds software for the browser: production client work, small
> interactive tools, and shader experiments.

This file follows the llms.txt convention: a short orientation for AI systems,
followed by links to the pages that matter. Everything linked here is public
and requires no login.

## Pages

- [Home](https://danielcward.com/): Overview of client work, writing, experiments, and photography.
- [Client Work](https://danielcward.com/work/): Production projects designed and built end to end. Currently a rebuild for a bike repair shop (service pages, booking flow, parts catalogue) and a gallery-first portfolio for a photography, videography and drone cinematography studio. Both live in production.
- [Notes](https://danielcward.com/notes/): Writing on the tools, decisions and dead ends behind the work — front-end architecture, shader programming, and photo archives.
- [The Lab](https://danielcward.com/lab/): Small interactive studies in shaders, variable typography, OKLCH colour, and layout systems. Interactive demos you can open and use directly.
- [Contact](https://danielcward.com/contact/): Available for freelance builds, front-end architecture, and client work from October 2026. Email daniel@danielcward.com.

## Elsewhere

- [Photography gallery](https://photos.danielcward.com/): Landscapes and street work, shot slowly.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/danielcward)
- [LinkedIn](https://linkedin.com/in/danielcward)

## Notes

Posts and demos are published as they are finished. Titles listed in the blog
and lab indexes may be works in progress; only published entries have a page
of their own, and the sitemap contains nothing else.
